[EN] If I Had a Hammer, I'd Kill Some Ossugons
[ES] Si tuviera un martillo, mataría a unos ossugons
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Those undead abominations are blocking the supply route!
[ES] ¡Esas abominaciones de muertos vivientes están bloqueando la ruta de suministros!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thanks! Now we might actually see a supply shipment!
[ES] ¡Gracias! ¡Ahora tal vez veamos un cargamento de suministros!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate the ossugon frostwalkers and icy skeletal minions in the eastern Frost Wastes.
[ES] Elimina a los caminantes del hielo ossugon y a los súbditos esqueléticos helados en el este de Frost Wastes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to be of assistance."
[ES] Un placer ayudar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to Mansur with the news the road is clear.
[ES] Infórmale a Mansur que el camino está despejado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
